suggestions.pitch: As a 1-5 rebuilding team, turning aging White and a mid-value WR into Aiyuk plus young RB Brooks to a contending 5-1 partner is the most plausible rebuild move.
White and Robinson to a contender for Watson and young RB Brooks shifts value toward the future at 0.73 likelihood.
White and Doubs for Jonathon Brooks sells veterans for a young piece with less lineup loss than the other offers.
